$schema: Manual polygon overrides for addresses where OSM lacks a building polygon. Keyed by slug (matches --slug flag or auto-generated slug from address). Polygon is an array of {lat, lon} vertices in any winding order; the system closes + orients automatically. Optional buildingColour (hex), levels, heightM tags propagate into evidence the same way OSM tags would.

240-highland.$comment: Single-family West Newton residence at 42.3435/-71.2215. Approximate 14×12m rectangular footprint centred on the geocoded address point. Replace with a satellite-traced polygon for higher fidelity.
